description: This file contains helper functions for parsing, validating, and retrieving environment variables for a Django project, with emphasis on safety and consistency. It also includes validation logic to enforce correct settings based on environment context.

methods.name: bool _truthy(val: str)
methods.description: Converts a string value to a boolean based on common truthy representations.

methods.name: bool env_bool(name: str, default: bool = False)
methods.description: Reads a boolean environment variable with support for various true/false string representations.

methods.name: Optional[str] env_str(name: str, default: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Reads a string environment variable, returning a default if missing or blank.

methods.name: List[str] env_list(name: str, default: Optional[List[str]] = None)
methods.description: Reads a list environment variable supporting JSON array, comma-separated, or whitespace-separated formats.

methods.name: str require_env(name: str, *, hint: str = "")
methods.description: Ensures a required environment variable is set; raises an error if missing.

methods.name: None validate_settings(*, debug: bool, environment: str)
methods.description: Performs validation on critical Django settings at import time, enforcing security and correctness rules.

ctags.name: env_bool
ctags.pattern: /^def env_bool(name: str, default: bool = False) -> bool:$/

ctags.name: env_list
ctags.pattern: /^def env_list(name: str, default: Optional[List[str]] = None) -> List[str]:$/

ctags.name: env_str
ctags.pattern: /^def env_str(name: str, default: Optional[str] = None) -> Optional[str]:$/

ctags.name: validate_settings
ctags.pattern: /^def validate_settings(*, debug: bool, environment: str) -> None:$/
